_note: Unattended runs, Brisbane time, run by tools/scheduler.mjs (started by start.sh). days = daily | weekdays | a comma list of mon..sun. A job with a command runs that script instead of a skill. The agent appends here through .claude/hooks/schedule.sh when Tariq says yes to a schedule; a slug must exist in .claude/skills/. Remove a line to stop it.

jobs._why_off: needs the Tariq Assistant app in Entra; flip enabled to true once tools/mail.mjs inbox works under the tariq user
